## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-juan late-Míng Chán compendium supplementing the earlier *Zhèngzōng xīnyìn* [正宗心印](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Titles/%E6%AD%A3%E5%AE%97%E5%BF%83%E5%8D%B0) tradition — a genealogical-cum-doctrinal record of orthodox-line (*zhèngzōng*) Chán mind-seal transmission. Title literally "Linked Fragrance of the Continuation of the *Zhèngzōng xīnyìn*"; *liánfāng* is a conventional term for a continuation-by-successor.

**Abstract**

Shàncàn supplies a continuation of the *Zhèngzōng xīnyìn* transmission record, adding figures of the generations after the earlier compilation. Brief in scale but participating in the general late-Míng interest in gathering Chán transmission materials into compact, practitioner-usable form. Preserved in the Xuzangjing.
